description: This file defines the GeoZone controller class within the Opencart admin module, handling events related to geographic zones such as adding, editing, and deleting geo zones. It primarily generates tasks for updating tax rates and country information based on changes to geo zones.

classes.name: GeoZone
classes.description: Controller class for handling events related to geographic zone modifications in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: addGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the event after a geo zone is added. It creates tasks to update tax rate information and country details related to the new geo zone.

methods.name: editGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the event before a geo zone is edited. It updates tasks for tax rate and country info, and manages country info for removed geo zones.

methods.name: deleteGeoZone
methods.description: Handles the event before a geo zone is deleted. It creates tasks to update tax rate info and country info for the affected geo zone.
